definitions.explanation: To push something or someone back the way it came, physically or figuratively (an attack, a crowd, a proposal).

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{返|かえ}した。
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: To push back the opponent's attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}され→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧で{押|お}し{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: Though the crowd pressed against me, I desperately pushed back.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{返|かえ}す. No intransitive partner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{返|かえ}す: to repel an attack
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{返|かえ}す: to push the opponent back (sumo, sports)
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{返|かえ}す: to push a document back (refusing it)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push) + ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to send back).
